name: Question
about: You're not sure how to do something, or something is confusing.

---

Before you fill this in, check [the FAQ](../../docs/faq.md) and [the troubleshooting page](../../docs/troubleshooting.md). A lot of questions are answered there already.

If yours isn't, ask away. There are no dumb questions here.

## What are you trying to do

What you're attempting overall, not just the step you're stuck on.

## Where you got stuck

What you tried and what happened. If you got an error message, paste it exactly. **Settings → System Logs → Copy all** often has the full text.

## Relay version

Open **Settings → Data & Alerts**. The **App updates** section says "You're on v…". It looks like `0.8.8`.

## Anything else

Screenshots, or links to docs you read that didn't fully answer it, so we know what to clarify.
